modules.description: List of built-in Knot Resolver modules to load

items.description: Name of a Knot Resolver module (e.g., 'cache', 'dnssec', 'stats')

listen_addresses.description: IP addresses and ports to listen on for DNS queries

items.description: Address and optional port in 'address#port' format (e.g., '127.0.0.1#53')

cache_size_mib.description: Maximum DNS cache size in mebibytes (MiB)

max_concurrent_queries.description: Maximum number of concurrent DNS queries allowed per client IP

trust_anchor_file.description: Path to the DNSSEC trust anchor file

forward_to.description: List of upstream resolver addresses to forward queries to (empty = direct resolution)

log_to_journal.description: Log to systemd journal (true) or to file (false)

log_file_path.description: Path to log file (used only if log_to_journal is false)

enable_query_log.description: Log every DNS query and response to a file for debugging

query_log_path.description: Path to query log file (used only if enable_query_log is true)

rate_limit_enabled.description: Enable per-client DNS query rate limiting

rate_limit_qps.description: Maximum queries per second per client IP (ignored if rate limiting disabled)

local_data.description: Static DNS records for local/internal domains (overrides network responses)

retry_count.description: Number of retries for failed upstream queries

anchor_auto_update.description: Automatically download and update DNSSEC trust anchors

strict_mode.description: Enable strict DNSSEC validation (RFC 8482) — fail on validation errors
